text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, February 4, 2019 Posted by admin on February 4th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -14 points.
Friday the Dow was up +64.22 (+0.26%) at 25,063.89.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +7.44%.
There were 17 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Visa (V) +3.81%, Exxon Mobil (XOM) +3.60% and Intel (INTC) +3.42%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Walmart (WMT) -2.06%, Caterpillar (CAT) -1.69% and Microsoft (MSFT) -1.58%.
Markets in mainland China are closed all week for a holiday.
Tuesday we have the State of the Union address.
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down one-tenth of a cent at $2.256 per gallon.
